data.body: Landed: Gerrit change 3508 patch set 1 (bed529b27a3) reached LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved; submitted revision-scoped; on origin/main as a99339e8ce8. AC evidence (tests/interfaces/store/test_write_after_reclaim_other_paths.py, all red without the src change, green with it): (1) test_delete_/test_import_/test_reconciler_pass_on_a_superseded_clone_* write on the reclaimed baseline. (2) test_completion_close_heals_a_superseded_clone_before_its_gates[off] reaches the verifier on the healed store (failed on 2e85d8558a4 with stale-store), [on] passes on both; test_gated_claim_/test_gated_start_work_transition_/test_claim_review_gate_check_* no longer report stale-store and leave HEAD on the reclaimed lineage; the atomic completion commit is unchanged (receipt-ancestry reason in the plan). (3) the *_against_an_unrelated_remote_* tests refuse delete, import, the reconciler pass (OPERATIONAL_FAILURE, no reconcile_once) and the completion close gate as DIVERGED and write nothing. (4) test_heal_with_a_failed_fetch_* (comment, delete, import, reconciler, gated claim, close) and test_heal_with_a_busy_write_lock_* (import, reconciler, gated claim, close) stay refused naming DIVERGED with HEAD, working tree, an unpushed local event and the remote unchanged and no stale-override backup ref. (5) make verify on bed529b27a3 exited 0. cli-main fast-forwarded to a99339e8ce8.
